  flag As Boolean
  nm As String * 10
  arr(3) As Long
EndStructureType

Public c As s
Public X

StructureType s
  v As Float
  Units v = mV
  ReadOnly v
EndStructureType
Public b(2,3) As s

  Scan(1,Sec,0,0)
  NextScan
EndProg

StructureType V
  f As Float
  Units f = Hz
  ReadOnly f
  g As Float
  arr(2) As Float
EndStructureType
StructureType M
  f As Float
  l As Long
  nm As String * 8
  b As Boolean
EndStructureType
Public P(3) As V
Public Q As V
Public R As M
DataTable(T,True,10)
  DataInterval(0,10,Sec,10)
  Sample(3,P,V)
  FieldNames("a,b ,c: d ")
  Average(3,P,V,False)
  FieldNames("a1,b1,c1")
  Maximum(1,Q,V,False,False)
  Sample(1,P(2),V)
  FieldNames("p2")
  Totalize(1,P(1),V,False)
  Sample(1,P(1).f,Float)
  FieldNames("pf")
EndTable
DataTable(T2,True,10)
  Sample(1,R,M)
EndTable
BeginProg
  Scan(1,Sec,0,0)
    CallTable T
    CallTable T2
  NextScan
EndProg
